|About Me |
My name is Odell Miller, I am a Doctor of Physical Therapy . I played Division 1 football where I then had the opportunity to tryout for two NFL teams. I also own two businesses and plan to open up multiple clinics in the future. My goals are to motivate and inspire others through not only my words but through my actions. I document my journey through YouTube vlogs and I make cool inspiring content on social media. I love meeting and connecting with new people. I encourage everyone to not hesitate to reach out and follow me on social media @odellmiller25.
